summary: Choose three repeatable battlefields and reuse prepared terrain and routes.
stage: Game overview and small-window menu captures
rationale: Uncropped real renders show the three distinct layouts; the selector shows the player control. Measured performance and its limits are recorded in docs/performance/loading-study.md. A genuine menu-to-battle capture shows both map selections, deployment progress and arrival; its generated fallback and 45x loading edit are explicit, with no timing claim.

capture.provenance: Captured during implementation of 1b52c9d8. Alder and Stonebridge overviews precede the final navigation-array copy fixes; generated/restored geometry parity was revalidated on the final build. Day lighting, high preset; no synthetic gameplay imagery.
capture.composition: Three complete 1280x720 source frames resized to 800x450, with plain labels; 1600x970 JPEG. Selector is complete 960x600 JPEG.

deployment.environment: Godot 4.7.2 ed1daf0bf, workspace-only Debian Xvfb, Mesa llvmpipe Compatibility. Prepared packages omitted in sparse checkout: generated fallback, Highland Junction seed 41. Private loopback host; no production services.
deployment.edit: Raw seconds 18-29 normal, 29-315 at 45x, 325-333 normal. Explicit on-video labels. Silent VP9, CRF32, 960x600.
deployment.validation: Actual changing-frame probe: 59 drawn frames. Selected Stonebridge at drawn frame 65, Highland Junction at 106, deployed at 130. Inspected popup, loading and revealed FOB frames and decoded final video. Capture manually stopped after visible arrival; no automated arrival-test or performance pass claimed.
